Lena (Sales): Quick sync ACME procurement pressing to sign the POC orderform today. They redlined the SLA and requested Net45 + PO. Need legal + finance input before I reply.
Amir (Legal): Share the redline snippet. If they changed the service credits or removed fallback language we should push back.
Lena (Sales): They swapped availability to 99.99% and proposed minute-level credits (per-minute). Also removed the fallback routing clause.
Amir (Legal): 99.99% is fine for Dedicated only. Suggest two-track response: (1) POC/orderform: keep 99.95% with a clear credit table; (2) Production/Dedicated: 99.99% available under separate SOW with surcharge. I'll draft.
Maya (Finance): On Net45: we can accept Net45 for annual/committed deals. For POC/orderform we require 50% prepay and invoice code mapping. If they insist on Net45 for POC, we need a finance-approved waiver.
Rohit (Solutions): Technical note: to realistically meet 99.99% you need multi-region warm standby + cross-region KV replication. For the small POC capacity (3 x a100 equiv, 800k tokens/day) that's disproportionate. Recommend keeping 99.95 for POC.
Lena (Sales): ACME also requested SOC2 report and the completed vendor security questionnaire attached to the order. I'll ask them for PO + billing name.
Amir (Legal): I'll insert this fallback language: "In the event of modeled capacity constraints, traffic will be routed to the listed fallback model; SLA credits apply only when no fallback was available and Redwood confirmed incident status." That prevents credit claims during known degraded-mode routing.
contract-bot: DocuSign envelope created for orderform 291234 (envelope id: env_0xdef456)
Lena (Sales): @Amir please include a sentence that the SLA references only the customer endpoints enumerated in the order form. Also note data residency requirement (EU-region) is called out separately.
Maya (Finance): I'll prepare an invoice template: 50% due on execution (prepay), remainder Net45 from invoice date. Billing code: ACME-INV-9922. Need legal entity name for PO.
Rohit (Solutions): Uploading SOC2 cert and latest security questionnaire export: https://drive.example.com/acme/poc-soc2-291234.zip
Lena (Sales): Good. Let's aim to send: (a) Marco's redline option A (99.95% + credits), (b) a commercial note that 99.99% is available for Dedicated with pricing, (c) SOC2 + questionnaire link, (d) invoice template requiring 50% prepay.
Amir (Legal): Drafted redline and comment: give them SLA table with monthly availability bands and credit percentages; avoid minute-level credits, use percentage-of-monthly-fee bands. Dropping in thread in 20.
Maya (Finance): Once we have signed orderform + customer PO I will issue invoice. If they send PO before signature, we need PO to reference envelope id or order number to match.
Lena (Sales): Action items summarised: Amir to post legal redline; Rohit to upload SOC2+questionnaire (done); Maya to prepare invoice template and prepay wording; I'll message ACME procurement for PO + tax/billing name. :thumbsup:
Amir (Legal): Redline posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/redlines/291234-sla-redline.docx
contract-bot: DocuSign envelope status updated: env_0xdef456 (status: sent -> viewed)
Lena (Sales): Thanks team. Ping me if ACME pushes Net45-only for the POC; we'll escalate.
